001package org.clafer.math;
002
003import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntObjectHashMap;
004
005/**
006 *
007 * @author jimmy
008 */
009public class MatrixBuilder {
010
011    private final TIntObjectHashMap<Rational>[] rows;
012    private final int numberOfColumns;
013
014    public MatrixBuilder(int rows, int columns) {
015        this.rows = (TIntObjectHashMap<Rational>[]) new TIntObjectHashMap<?>[rows];
016        this.numberOfColumns = columns;
017    }
018
019    public Rational get(int row, int column) {
020        if (rows[row] == null) {
021            return Rational.Zero;
022        }
023        Rational value = rows[row].get(column);
024        return value == null ? Rational.Zero : value;
025    }
026
027    public void set(int row, int column, Rational value) {
028        if (rows[row] == null) {
029            rows[row] = new TIntObjectHashMap<>(4);
030        }
031        rows[row].put(column, value);
032    }
033
034    public int numberOfRows() {
035        return rows.length;
036    }
037
038    public int numberOfColumns() {
039        return numberOfColumns;
040    }
041
042    public Matrix toMatrix() {
043        return new Matrix(rows, numberOfColumns);
044    }
045}
